_comment: SF renter-facing taxonomy for the Building Brief.
Groups are the STATUTORY elements of habitability, not the A/B/C severity
tiers in SF_EXPANSION_PLAN.md. Those tiers weight a risk score; this file
names a hazard for a reader. Keeping them separate is deliberate — a weight
and a name are different jobs and conflating them produced NYC's worst copy.
`minor_categories` holds DataSF 311 `service_subtype` values, matching the
key name NYC's taxonomy uses for the same role (complaint category -> group)
so one loader serves both cities.
`violation_categories` holds `sf_dbi_nov.nov_category_description` values,
uppercased because `group_of_violation_category` uppercases before lookup.
Only four appear: they are the NOV categories that name a CONDITION and map
to exactly one group. Most of the rest are code-section labels ('building
section', 'other section', blank) covering 52.7% of rows, and a rule built
on them would point at nothing.
Two NOV categories that look like conditions are still absent, and
deliberately: 'interior surfaces section' spans peeling paint, weather
protection and plumbing, and 'plumbing and electrical section' spans two
groups by its own name. Mapping either to a single group would attribute a
violation to a condition it may not describe.
'sanitation section' WAS in that list, excluded as spanning pests and
garbage. It came back in when the garbage group was widened to sanitation:
the statutory element it cites is one thing — 'clean and sanitary buildings,
grounds, and appurtenances, free from debris, filth, rubbish, garbage,
rodents, and vermin' — so filth and refuse are not two groups. A
rodent-proofing NOV landing here reads as cleanliness rather than pests,
which under-claims rather than misstates.
There is no `violation_category_tooltips` block. NYC has 48 authored
sentences because its class C rule covers many conditions at once and needs
to name which; every SF rule names its own condition, so nothing here is
abstract enough to need a per-category gloss.
`violation_patterns` is a THIRD way a group gets a signal, alongside 311
subtypes and NOV categories: a POSIX regex over the violation text. Used
only where the condition exists in DBI's wording but has no 311 subtype and
no category of its own — `interior_surfaces` is the case that forced it, at
647 parcels with no complaint category anywhere in the 311 feed.
A row may match SEVERAL groups' patterns and that is correct, not a bug: one
NOV item routinely carries multiple orders ('a) locate and repair source of
water damage b) repair damaged ceilings'). Each group counts independently.
`excluded_subtypes` makes this file a COMPLETE partition of the 37 observed
service_subtype values rather than a subset. A test asserts that: a subtype
that is neither grouped nor explicitly excluded is a new DataSF value that
someone has to make a decision about, and silence would drop it forever.

pests.label: Pests
pests.description: Rodents, insects, or bed bugs reported in the building.

mold.label: Mold
mold.description: Mold or mildew reported in the building.

plumbing.label: Plumbing
plumbing.description: Broken or leaking plumbing, or bathroom fixtures that do not work.

weather_windows.label: Exterior & windows
weather_windows.description: Weather protection and exterior upkeep, and windows or doors that do not close properly.

heat_hot_water.label: Heat / hot water
heat_hot_water.description: No heat, or no hot water.

fire_safety.label: Fire safety
fire_safety.description: Blocked exits, fire hazards, or problems with alarms, sprinklers and extinguishers.

interior_surfaces.label: Walls, ceilings & cabinets
interior_surfaces.description: Damaged or deteriorated interior fabric of the unit — walls, ceilings and built-in cabinetry — whether or not a leak is named as the cause.

peeling_paint.label: Peeling paint
peeling_paint.description: Paint peeling or flaking inside or outside the building.

electrical.label: Electrical
electrical.description: Hazardous or faulty wiring and fixtures, or too few outlets.

ventilation_light.label: Ventilation & light
ventilation_light.description: Inadequate ventilation, or rooms without enough natural light.

sanitation.label: Cleanliness & refuse
sanitation.description: Accumulated filth or debris in common areas, or trash receptacles missing, overflowing, or in poor repair.

lead_paint.label: Lead paint
lead_paint.description: Paint work done without the practices required to control lead dust.

security_locks.label: Locks & security
security_locks.description: Entry doors or windows that do not lock securely.

floors_stairs.label: Floors & stairs
floors_stairs.description: Floors, stairways, decks, or handrails in poor repair.

mailbox.label: Mailboxes
mailbox.description: Mail delivery problems, or mailboxes that do not lock.

smoke_detectors.label: Smoke detectors
smoke_detectors.description: Smoke detectors missing or not working.

excluded_subtypes.general_maintenance_not_in_list_above: Opaque bucket. Names no condition, so an item built on it would point at nothing — the same defect as the NOV 'other section'. 1,034 parcels, and excluding it is the single largest judgement in this file.
excluded_subtypes.clutter_hoarder_unit_interior_storage: Frequently tenant-caused and inside a unit. Every rule here frames a condition as the owner's to fix; that framing would misattribute this one.
excluded_subtypes.elevators_everthing_else: KNOWN GAP, not a judgement. No source among the gathered documents covers elevators. See AI_METHODOLOGY.md, 'SF: authored, and why'.
excluded_subtypes.elevators_no_working_elevator_7_or_more_: KNOWN GAP. 388 parcels across both elevator subtypes, larger than heat at the >1 threshold, and a real habitability problem for anyone with limited mobility — but uncitable with the sources in hand.
excluded_subtypes.second_hand_smoke: No source among the gathered documents.
excluded_subtypes.noise_caused_by_building_systems: Not a habitability element in any gathered source.
excluded_subtypes.kitchen_community: Shared SRO kitchens. Plausibly covered by Housing Code §1001(b) sanitation, but not clearly enough to author from.
excluded_subtypes.illegal_construction_no_permit_exceeds_p: Permitting enforcement, not a building condition. Already weight 0 in the risk score.
excluded_subtypes.illegal_guest_room_conversions: Regulatory, not a building condition. Already weight 0.
excluded_subtypes.visitor_policy_violations: Lease-policy enforcement, not a building condition. Already weight 0.
excluded_subtypes.building -: Single junk row in the source data.
